NotationDescription
N, P, S, Fconstellation parameters: the number of satellites, planes,and satellites per plane, constellation phasing factor
\mathcal{N}, nset and index of satellites
N_n, mset and index of satellite n's neighbors
\mathcal{T}, tset and index of time slots
(n, m)index of physical links
c_ncomputation service rate of n
b_{nm}(t)transmission capacity of (n, m) in t
T_{nm}(t)propagation delay of (n, m) in t
\mathcal{I}, I(t)set of all active users and set of active users in t
I_n(t)set of active users in n's coverage in t
s^itask i's size
h^itask i's required number of cycles for processing one bit
t_0^i, d_{max}^itask i's arrival slot and deadline
a_n^i(t)task i's admission decision on n in t
a_n(t)arrival rate on n in t
\mathbf{Q}_n^F(t)set of task requests waiting for offloading decisions in t
\mathbf{Q}_n^B(t)set of requests for tasks to be computed in t
Q_n^F(t)workload amount of forwarding on n in t
Q_n^B(t)workload amount of computing on n in t
\alpha_n^i(t)task i's local computing desision on n in t
\alpha_n(t)amount of n's local computing workloads in t
\beta_{nm}^i(t)task i's offloading desision from n to m in t
\beta_{nm}(t)amount of offloading workloads from n to m in t
\beta_n(t)amount of offloading workloads out of n in t
p^i, n_k^itask i's offloading path and intermediate node
r_n^i(t)task i's processed workloads on n in t
d_n^{i,C}, e_n^{i,C}computation delay and energy consumption of i on n
P_ttransmission power
d^{i,T}offloading delay of i
e^{i,T}transmission energy consumption of i
\rho_d, \rho_eweighting parameters of delay and energy consumption
E_n, B_{nm}local computing capacity, offloading capacity
